text.en: Talking pays by how often you talk: keep a two-way chat going and you gain about 1.1 times as fast as grinding, one line an hour pays only a little. Any words count, a private message counts from any place, and speaking directly to an NPC where you stand (say with target set to its id) gets a reply and a smaller reward.
text.zh-CN: 论道改成多聊多得:一直聊下去约为练级的 1.1 倍,每小时只说一句只得一点。聊什么都算,私话隔地也算;对同地 NPC 发私话(target 填它的 id)对方会回一句,你也得修为,但比与玩家论道少。
